_about: Generated by tools/whatsnew_v141.py - do not edit. Screenshots taken on the v1.4.1 ROM itself (r09), mGBA 0.10.5 engine. The title screen of v1.4.1 still shows v1.4 by owner decision, so the v1.4 title picture is correct.
heading: The portable Pokémon PC
lead: Press R on the party screen to open Pokémon Storage without walking back to a Pokémon Center.
desc: the portable Pokémon PC: press R on the party screen to open Pokémon Storage

shots.title: Press R on the party screen
shots.caption: START, POKéMON: the new R◆PC hint sits beside SEL◆ORDER. Press R to open Pokémon Storage.

shots.title: Your boxes, anywhere
shots.caption: The same Pokémon Storage as a Pokémon Center PC. Close it and you are back on the party screen.

shots.title: Deposit and withdraw
shots.caption: Move Pokémon between your party and your boxes, read their summaries and rearrange your boxes. HP, PP and status conditions stay as they are.

shots.title: Battle Frontier
shots.caption: It works in the Frontier’s Pokémon Center, Mart, Lounges and outdoor areas, and not during a challenge.

shots.title: Where it is off
shots.caption: In the Battle Pike and other special challenges the hint is gone and the party screen works as usual.
